description: 8px base grid for consistent panel padding, gaps, and layout rhythm across the 6-panel dashboard.
usage_notes: Stick to the scale — no arbitrary pixel values in panel CSS. This is what keeps a 6-panel dashboard built by a non-technical lead under time pressure from drifting misaligned.
On mobile, all panel_spans collapse to full width (4/4) in the fixed order: key_metrics, pareto_front, mission_profile, battery_soc, constraint_checker, assumptions.
